event_v0.doc: One payout line settled. `pushed` distinguishes the operator batch from a\nholder claim, so the UI can say "received" vs "claimed" without heuristics.
event_v0.name: Paid

udt_struct_v0.doc: One distribution round for one asset.
udt_struct_v0.name: Cycle

fields.doc: Cumulative amount already paid out (push + claims).
fields.name: claimed

fields.doc: Unix time after which claims close and `sweep` opens.
fields.name: expires_at

fields.doc: Merkle root of the payout list (see [`merkle`]).
fields.name: root

fields.doc: Ledger at which holder balances were read. Audit trail only.
fields.name: snapshot_ledger

fields.doc: Set once the remainder has been swept; the cycle is then closed.
fields.name: swept

fields.doc: RWA token whose holders this cycle pays. Informational + indexed; the\npayout set itself is fixed by `root`.
fields.name: token

fields.doc: USDC deposited for this cycle (payment stroops).
fields.name: total

udt_struct_v0.doc: One payout line of a push batch.
udt_struct_v0.name: Entry

cases.doc: `expires_at` is not in the future at cycle creation.
cases.name: InvalidExpiry

cases.doc: The line's (cycle, holder, amount) does not hash into the cycle root.
cases.name: InvalidProof

cases.doc: This holder's line was already paid (pushed or claimed).
cases.name: AlreadyPaid

cases.name: CycleExpired

event_v0.doc: A cycle's unpaid remainder was recovered; the cycle is closed.

function_v0.doc:
Claim one payout line. The holder authorizes the call (their signed
inner transaction may be fee-bumped by the platform \xe2\x80\x94 the signature
stays theirs). Panics if the line was already paid, the proof does not
match, or the cycle expired. Returns the amount paid.
function_v0.name: claim

function_v0.doc: Admin: recover whatever a cycle never paid out, once it has expired.\nCloses the cycle for good. Returns the swept amount.
function_v0.name: sweep

event_v0.doc: A distribution cycle was opened and funded.
event_v0.name: CycleCreated

function_v0.doc: USDC still unpaid in a cycle (0 once swept).
function_v0.name: unclaimed

function_v0.doc: Anyone: re-extend a cycle's storage TTL. Purely maintenance \xe2\x80\x94 a cycle\nwith a long claim window must not be archived before it expires.
function_v0.name: bump_cycle

function_v0.doc: Number of cycles ever created (ids are `0..cycle_count`).
function_v0.name: cycle_count

function_v0.doc: Admin: open a distribution cycle. Pulls `total` USDC from the admin\ninto this contract and publishes the payout list's Merkle `root`.\nReturns the cycle id.
function_v0.name: create_cycle

function_v0.doc: Runs once at deploy. `pay_sac` is the USDC Stellar Asset Contract.
function_v0.name: __constructor

function_v0.doc:
Admin: push a batch of payout lines. Lines already paid are skipped, so
overlapping batches are harmless; an invalid proof aborts the whole
batch \xe2\x80\x94 a bad line in an operator batch is a bug, not a holder mistake.
Returns the amount actually paid by this batch.

Deliberately usable after `expires_at` (until the sweep): expiry closes
self-service claims, not the operator settling a laggard.
function_v0.name: distribute_for
